What the Reader Should Do

This section translates theory into practice. The goal is to help readers recognize communication breakdowns, ask better questions, and choose more effective response strategies.

You can organize your guidance by context (personal, workplace, civic, online), then connect each recommendation to a specific theoretical lens.

Include checklists, reflective prompts, and scenario-based advice so readers can apply concepts immediately.
